desc.en: At the time of meeting with the brothers in-faith say the following…
desc.rurdu: Is din jab apne momin bhaiyo’n se mulaqaat kare to is tarah se kahe…

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِىْ جَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَمَسِّكِيْنَ بِوِلَايَةِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْاَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ۔

trans.en: Praise be to Allah, who blessed us to be among those who cling and hold to the Wilayaat (love, and authority) of Ameer Al Momineen and all the Imams, peace be on them all.
trans.rurdu: Hamd hai Allah ke liye jisne hamein Amirul Momeneen (a.s) ki aur unke baad Aimma (a.s) ki wilaayat ko maanne waalo’n mein se qaraar diya hai.

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِىْ اَكْرَمَنَا بِهٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُوْفِنَ، بِعَهْدِهٖ اِلَيْنَا وَمِيْثَاقِهِ الَّذِىْ وَاثَقَنَا بِهٖ مِنْ وِّلَايَةِ وُلَاةِ اَمْرِهٖ وَالْقَوَّامِ بِقِسْطِهٖ، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْجَاحِدِيْنَ وَالْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّيْنَ۔

trans.en: Praise be to Allah who honored us with this day, and included us among those who have been given all that which was promised to them, and have been tied together with the bonds of contract to have full confidence in the authority of the guardians of the religious laws who established justice; and did not disgrace us to be among those who know better but deny the truth and treat the Day of Judgment as a false fable.
trans.rurdu: Hamd hai Allah ke liye jisne aaj ke din ke zariye hamein izzat di aur hamein us ahad ko wafa karne waala banaya jo hamare supurd (hawaale) kiya aur woh paimaan (waada) jo hamse wilaayat Amirul Momeneen (a.s) apne waaliyaane amr aur adl par qaaem rehne waalo’n ke baare mein liye aur hamein roze Qayaamat ka inkaar karne waalo’n aur usey juthlaane waalo’n mein nahi rakkha.

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ كَمَالَ دِيْنِهٖ وَتَمَامَ نِعْمَتِهٖ بِوَلَايَةِ اَمِيْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ۔

trans.en: Praise be to Allah, who had perfected His religion and completed His favour with the establishment of Ali ibn Abi Talib’s authority, peace be on him.
trans.rurdu: Hamd hai Allah ke liye jisne apne deen ke kamaal aur neymat ke etemaam ko Amirul Momeneen Hazrat Ali ibne Abi Talib (a.s) ki wilaayat ke saath mashrut (conditions) qaraar diya.
